overview.description: With an affinity tag (designed in at the gBlock stage), purification is tractable: the tag binds a substrate (His-tag to Ni-NTA), contaminants wash away, then a competitor (imidazole) elutes your protein. FPLC scales this up; gravity columns work on a budget.
objectives: bind, wash and elute a His-tagged protein on Ni-NTA
use imidazole gradients to maximise purity
consider cheaper tags (Car9/silica) at design time
prerequisites: clarified lysate with a tagged protein

steps.intro: With an affinity tag (designed in at the gBlock stage), purification is tractable: the tag binds a substrate (His-tag to Ni-NTA), contaminants wash away, then a competitor (imidazole) elutes your protein. FPLC scales this up; gravity columns work on a budget.

instructions.title: Bind
instructions.description: Apply cleared lysate to equilibrated Ni-NTA resin so the His-tag binds the nickel.

instructions.title: Wash
instructions.description: Wash with low-imidazole buffer (~20-30 mM) to remove weakly-bound contaminants.

instructions.title: Elute
instructions.description: Elute with high imidazole (~250-500 mM); collect fractions for analysis.

instructions.title: Analyse
instructions.description: Save load, flow-through, wash and elution fractions for SDS-PAGE.

submission.description: Purify a tagged protein and submit the fraction set (load/FT/wash/elution) ready for an SDS-PAGE gel.
